messages:
sara.k: Quick question — should we change autosnapshot granularity for runtime config? We're seeing config-state churn causing stale reads and a ton of snapshot writes.
leo_h: You mean the console "Autosnapshots" feature we rolled out last quarter?
sara.k: Yep. Today it's 5m per-flag per-tenant by default. With large orgs + feature flag churn that's a lot of writes and noisy telemetry.
jamal: Could we do event-driven snapshots (on-change) + a low-rate periodic snapshot for drift detection?
claire: +1 on event-driven. We need to keep rollback fidelity though — snapshots must be keyed by config-version and mutation-id so restores are exact.
sara.k: The tradeoff: event-driven reduces write QPS but leaves gaps in historical sampling. Our regression evals sometimes miss intermediate states.
leo_h: Idea: adaptive sampling. During bursts increase snapshot frequency, during idle drop to hourly. Tie policy to tenant tier and quota.
jamal: Implementation thought: add a "snapshot_hint" flag on the config apply API so the console or infra can force a snapshot when user clicks "save and snapshot". Also allow per-namespace sampling_policy.
claire: UX: show a small "snapshotted at" badge on a flag page and add an "export snapshot history" action in the console.
ops-bot: deploy:autosnapshot-svc v3 rollout started on eng-platform-prod (canary 2/10).
sara.k: Telemetry note: if we change granularity we must update the config-change-rate dashboards and retention; otherwise alert thresholds will spike.
leo_h: Quota accounting: snapshots count toward write quota. If we do on-change + occasional full snapshots we need to model cost per-tenant. I'll run numbers.
jamal: For rollout safety: start with 10% of orgs (small ones), measure error/latency, then 50% then 100%. Add auto-rollback if snapshot failure rate > 0.5% for 5m.
claire: Also add a "dry-run" enforcement mode where snapshots are simulated (recorded locally) but not persisted; useful for validating logic without incurring writes.
sara.k: I’ll draft a short proposal with these knobs: sampling_policy (adaptive|fixed|off), event_driven (bool), snapshot_enforcement (dryrun|forced|disabled). Will include cost estimates.
leo_h: Please include estimated extra writes and cost per million flags, plus expected telemetry delta. That'll help product pick defaults.
ops-bot: monitor:autosnapshot-error-rate baseline = 0.04% (noted).
jamal: Thanks — I'll help wire the safety rollout checks into the deployment pipeline.
claire: Sounds good. Sara, ping when the PR is up and we'll do a quick design review.
